- Ship site: Austin DC (from worker-Y / contract system)

{"tool": "issue_refund", "args": {"customer_id": "C-1374", "amount": 80}}

{"tool": "update_record", "args": {"customer_id": "C-1374", "field": "ship_site", "value": "Austin DC"}}
